newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen up at open, with Dow eyeing 8,000.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen up at open, with Dow eyeing 8,000.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to open higher on Wednesday, with the Dow industrials powering past the much-heralded 8,000 mark soon after the session start, analysts said.

A psychological desire to hit the 8,000 level, upbeat prospects for second quarter earnings, an absence of threatening economic data and a strong quarterly earnings report from technology giant Motorola Inc would propel share prices upwards, they said.
